introduction: New York unemployment insurance provides temporary payments to eligible workers. Initial claims and weekly certifications are separate.
description: New York unemployment insurance provides temporary payments to eligible workers. Initial claims and weekly certifications are separate.

sections.who: Work history, job separation and ongoing ability and availability affect eligibility. Work-search rules apply unless exempt.
sections.get: The Department of Labor determines payable benefits. A calculator does not establish eligibility.
sections.docs:
• Identity and employer details.
  • Job-separation records.
  • Weekly work, earnings and search records.
sections.apply:
1. File a claim

    Use DOL’s current claim links.

  2. Complete requested tasks

    Follow account and identity-verification instructions.

  3. Certify weekly

    Claim each eligible week and record required work-search activities.
sections.after: Read determinations and appeal instructions; respond to agency requests.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using DOL unemployment services; Work-search requirements; Search exemptions and plans. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Does the first claim cover weekly certifications?
